page_content: The main sewer line has burst near the metro pillar 42, causing black water to flood the entire service road. It smells terrible and is a major health hazard.
There are live electrical wires hanging very low from the pole near the vegetable market. It is sparking whenever it touches the nearby tree branches.
The garbage collection van has not visited our colony in the last 4 days. The main bin at the entrance is overflowing and attracting stray dogs.
A huge pothole has formed right in the middle of the junction near the civil hospital. Several bikers have almost slipped today trying to avoid it.
The swings in the local children's park are rusted and the chains are about to snap. It's very dangerous for the kids playing there in the evening.
The zebra crossing paint near the primary school gate has completely faded away. Drivers are not slowing down, making it hard for kids to cross.
There is a strong chemical smell coming from the basement of the abandoned building near the market. Residents are complaining of headaches.
The streetlights on the entire stretch of the flyover are not working. It's completely pitch black at night and feels very unsafe for women commuters.
Illegal construction is happening behind the apartment complex. They are dumping bricks and sand on the public road, blocking half the lane.
The fire exit door in the local community hall is jammed and won't open. This needs to be fixed before the function this weekend.
